# Learning procedures reconstructed through actual performance / 学习方式经实际表现进入重构

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`learned-procedure-transmission` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F09 · [record](learned-procedure-transmission.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> In the declared construction, every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network and procedure bit, builds as many successors as capacity allows and conserves material and support, so whole performance can alter reconstruction of the procedure that governs internal change.
>
> 在所述构造中，每次接触之后的忠实重构都传递接触所留的网络与更新控制位，按容量建成后继，并保持材料与支持；整体表现由此能改变内部更新方式的重构。

## Laws / 规律

1. An exposure of the declared construction runs exactly when some formation is active and the source covers every active formation's demand on every task.<br>所述构造的接触恰在有形成活跃、且来源足以覆盖每个活跃形成在每项任务上的需求时进行。 (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.expose_isSome_iff`)
2. Every exposure keeps the apparatus, writes the network its run leaves and marks the state tested.<br>每次接触保留装置、写入其运行所留的网络、标为已测。 (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.exposed_kit`)
3. A reconstruction runs exactly when the state is tested and the precursor and support build at least one successor.<br>重构恰在状态已测、且前体与支持足以建成至少一个后继时进行。 (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.reconstruct_isSome_iff`)
4. Every reconstruction builds its successors, untested, from the transfer's inherited record and procedure bit.<br>每次重构以转移所继承的记录与更新控制位建成未测的后继。 (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.reconstruct_inherits`)
5. The law of transmission: every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network the exposure left and the procedure bit the exposed formation had, builds as many successors as the capacity allows, and conserves material and support.<br>传递之律：每次接触之后的忠实重构，都传递接触所留的网络与被接触形成的更新控制位，按容量建成后继，并保持材料与支持账。 (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.cycle_transmits`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.exposed_accounts`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.reconstructed_accounts`)
6. Under the declared task, support and construction laws, two encounters form a retained network from zero; actual subsequent responses supply computed reconstruction of its matrix and operative updater bit, and reconstructed successors use them; the constructed history is an instance of the law of transmission.<br>在给定任务、支承和构造规律内，两次接触从零形成保留网络；后续实际反应提供按量重构其矩阵和更新控制的支持，后继实际使用所得；所构造的历史是这一传递定律的实例。 (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.actual_acquisition_prefix`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.actual_parent_history`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.actual_reconstruction`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.actual_successor_exposure`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.reconstructed_record_enters_use`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.history_transmits`)
7. The connected history preserves material and support without resetting failed acquisition.<br>相连历史保持材料及支持账而不重置失败取得。 (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.complete_formation_transmission_use`)
8. The capacity is the longest lineage one shared pool releases: reading a successor’s thirteen precursor units as a word of one kind of token, the precursor held as the pool and its twenty support units as drawn at release, n successors are released in turn exactly when n is within the capacity, so a reconstruction builds exactly the longest lineage released (an instance of Copying.lineage_all_iff).<br>容量即一个共享池所释放的最长谱系：后继的十三单位前体读作同一种记号的词、所持前体为池、二十单位支持在释放时汲取，n 个后继依次释放恰当 n 在容量之内，故重构恰建成所释放的最长谱系（Copying.lineage_all_iff 的实例）。 (`Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.lineage_released_iff`, `Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.reconstruction_builds_longest_lineage`)
9. Every course of exposures and reconstructions conserves material and support, not one cycle only (an instance of Stock.trace_balance with nothing drawn or replenished).<br>每条由接触与重构组成的路径都保存材料与支持，不只一个循环（Stock.trace_balance 的实例，无汲取无补充）。 (`Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.material_balanced`, `Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.support_balanced`, `Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.course_conserves`)
10. Faithful reconstruction raises and lowers nothing, so the successors’ total of the procedure bit is the families’ bits weighted by their successor counts, each its capacity (the counting form of Price’s equation); in the history two of three successors carry the responsive procedure where one of two parents did.<br>忠实重构不升不降，后继中控制位的总数即各家族之位以其后继数（即容量）加权（Price 方程的计数形式）；历史中三个后继有两个带响应的更新方式，两个亲代中只有一个。 (`Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.faithful_selects`, `Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.history_selects`)

## Conditions / 条件

- Initial hardware, two updating procedures, three-coordinate tanh response and selected-update laws, affine channels and task encounters are supplied.<br>初始硬件、两种更新方式、三坐标tanh反应与选择更新规律、仿射通道及任务接触给定。
- One finite source opportunity per task converts to available support exactly on actual success. Reconstruction consumes thirteen precursor and twenty support units, including the ten-unit apparatus build; these are local recipes, not universal physical requirements or source replenishment.<br>每次任务一单位有限来源仅在实际成功时转为可用支持。每个重构消耗十三单位前体及二十支持，包含十单位装置构造；这是局部配方，不是普遍物理需求或来源再生。
- Exact real-valued matrix copying, source-associated reconstruction, freshly acquired calibration and homogeneous families with separate matched stocks remain idealized premises. The reconstruction recipe itself does not evolve here.<br>实数矩阵精确复制、与来源保持关联的重构、新取得校准及分开匹配存量的同质群体均为明示理想条件；重构配方自身在本模块不演化。

## Does not show / 未表明

- One finite conditional composition, not a mixed-population invasion model, origin of all learning rules, ecological replenishment, universal generative convergence or complete cognition.<br>一个有限条件组合，不是混合群体入侵模型、全部学习规律起源、生态再生、普遍生成对齐或完整认知。
- Absolute continuation, relative representation and shared renewal remain distinct; relative-frequency increase is not required for every generative contribution.<br>绝对接续、相对占比及共同更新分别保留；不是每项生成贡献都须提高相对频率。
- Conventional models with the same relations keep equal explanatory standing.<br>同关系的常规模型具有同等解释地位。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Procedure conversion or record erasure preserves offspring count while altering later use. C-only tasks equalize returns; limited precursor equalizes reconstruction counts. Support/source shortages block stages. The changed-channel failure uses a separately declared impaired entrance, not the main successor history.<br>更新控制转化或记录擦除可保留后继数量而改变使用；单一C任务使回报相同，有限前体使数量相同。支持或来源不足阻断阶段；通道变化失败用另行明示的受损入口，不冒充主后继历史。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/evolution-connectionism/LearnedProcedureTransmission.lean)

## Next / 下一步

For a stronger renewal claim, replace the supplied performance-to-support correspondence with an identified renewing activity and trace reconstruction under changed conditions.<br>更强更新主张须将给定表现—支持对应接到独立识别的更新活动，并追踪条件变化后的重构。

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history / 对应、依赖、来源与沿革</summary>

### Correspondence / 对应

Consequences of one organized activity affect reconstruction of its operative components; no independent reward is assigned to each component. The network and updater bit are inherited while channel references are reacquired. Gradients, institutional evaluation and biological reproduction are separate implementations of consequential change, not identical algorithms. Actual task success is not identified with wider generative good.<br>同一组织活动的后果影响其组成关系的重构，不给每部分独立报酬。网络及更新控制传递，而通道参考重新取得。梯度、制度评估及生物繁殖是后果改变组织的不同实现，不是同一算法；实际任务成功不被等同于整体生成性。
